_comment: xpr_cutover_voter config. Copy, fill in, chmod 600. The voter refuses to start if either key file is readable by group or others.
source_chain_id: <64 hex chars of the XPR chain id, published with the ceremony>

confirmation._comment: Either point at the coordinator (recommended: params are cross-checked against the local node) or fill in checkpoint/genesis explicitly. platform_chain_id is the MetalGo blockchain id wallets sign under, from the ceremony config; the restore gate refuses confirmations that do not bind it.
confirmation.platform_chain_id: <64 hex chars of the MetalGo blockchain id, published with the ceremony>

stop_producer._comment: Opt-in local halt. When at_h is true, the voter pauses its own producer (Leap producer/pause) after delivering the confirmation for H, then proves it is paused. A contract cannot stop block production, only the producer can. Omit or set at_h false and the voter signs without ever pausing. producer_api_url must be the LOCAL producer node, not a shared API endpoint.
